stories.title: How much control should we have over the algorithm? - podcast
stories.summary: Australia's proposed digital duty-of-care laws could give social media users the option to switch off recommendation algorithms. A Guardian podcast examines whether that would make platforms safer as the Coalition warns about censorship and technology companies defend feeds that underpin their revenue.
